name: jl-jewellers-erp
description: JL Jewellers ERP — MySQL + Express backend, React frontend. Target: Windows desktop app via Electron.

scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
